title: A morphism of inverse systems induces a (non-unique) morphism of derived limits
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category], and let $(K_n,f_n)_{n\geq1}$, $(K'_n,f'_n)_{n\geq1}$ be inverse systems of objects of $\mathcal D$ [def-weil-inverse-system] whose products exist [def-weil-category-product], with transition endomorphisms $1-s$, $1-s'$ [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism]. Let $K\xrightarrow{p}\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{1-s}\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{\delta}K[1]$ and $K'\xrightarrow{p'}\prod_nK'_n\xrightarrow{1-s'}\prod_nK'_n\xrightarrow{\delta'}K'[1]$ be distinguished triangles (Roos triangles; $K$, $K'$ are derived limits [def-weil-derived-limit]), and let $(\varphi_n):(K_n,f_n)\to(K'_n,f'_n)$ be a morphism of inverse systems. Then there exists a morphism $\varphi:K\to K'$ with $p'\circ\varphi=(\prod_n\varphi_n)\circ p$ and $\varphi[1]\circ\delta=\delta'\circ\prod_n\varphi_n$, i.e. $(\varphi,\prod_n\varphi_n,\prod_n\varphi_n)$ is a morphism of triangles. The morphism $\varphi$ is in general not unique.

source.place: Stacks Project, Derived Categories, Remark Tag 0H9J (remark-functoriality-derived-limit), derived.tex line 10525, in the case $m(n)=n$ where $a'=a''=\prod_na_n$: "by TR3 we obtain the dotted arrow producing a morphism of distinguished triangles. We warn the reader that the map $K\to L$ is not unique."

proof.text: Let a = Limits.Pi.map (fun n => φ.app ⟨n⟩). Naturality of φ on (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n 1)).op, simplified by Functor.ofOpSequence_map_homOfLE_succ, gives φ_(n+1) ≫ f′_n = f_n ≫ φ_n. Apply CategoryTheory.towerTransitionEndomorphism_natural_backward from def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism to obtain a ≫ (1-s′) = (1-s) ≫ a. This lemma already proves the componentwise product calculation using the product universal property in def-weil-category-product and preadditivity in def-weil-triangulated-category.

proof.text: Apply CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism₁ to Triangle.mk p (towerTransitionEndomorphism f) δ and Triangle.mk p′ (towerTransitionEndomorphism f′) δ′, distinguished by the supplied hypotheses, with both middle maps equal to a and commutation the symmetric equality of step 1. This Mathlib lemma implements TR2/TR3 of def-weil-triangulated-category: rotate both triangles, complete the square, and use full faithfulness and additivity of the shift to cancel the signs and descend the completed map to ψ : L ⟶ L′.

source.place: Tag 0H9J, remark-functoriality-derived-limit, with m(n)=n; Tag 0145, definition-triangulated-category, TR2 and TR3

proof.text: The completion lemma returns p ≫ a = ψ ≫ p′ and δ ≫ ψ⟦1⟧′ = a ≫ δ′. Reverse the first equality and package ψ with these two equations. The middle square is step 1, so these equations give the desired morphism of the specified Roos triangles. The existential completion makes no uniqueness or functorial-choice assertion.
